items.headline: Average DAM (Southern proxy) MCP: Rs 3036.54/MWh
items.detail: Day-ahead market average clearing price for 2026-07-07 was Rs 3036.54/MWh across 96 15-min blocks (range Rs 300.78-9499.19/MWh).

raw_values.region_note: Karnataka has no standalone day-ahead price; this uses the IEX Southern-region area clearing price as a proxy (see scope-note.md).

items.headline: Peak-hour (18:00-24:00) MCP premium: +72.7% vs daily avg
items.detail: Peak-hour average MCP was Rs 5243.48/MWh vs the day's overall average of Rs 3036.54/MWh, a +72.7% divergence.

raw_values.region_note: Karnataka has no standalone day-ahead price; this uses the IEX Southern-region area clearing price as a proxy (see scope-note.md).

items.headline: Wide intraday MCP spread: 303% of daily average
items.detail: Max-min spread of Rs 9499.19 - Rs 300.78 = 303% of the daily average, indicating high intraday volatility.
